title: Personal Checking: age, military and employee waivers of the monthly maintenance fee
content:
## Scope

Some Personal Checking tiers waive the monthly maintenance fee because of who the primary owner is rather than how the account is used. This table shows, per tier, the two age-based waiver levels and whether an active-duty military status or an active PCB employee status on the customer profile waives the fee.

## Profile-based waivers by tier

| Tier | Waived while the primary owner is younger than (years) | Waived when the primary owner is at least (years) | Active-duty military status waives the fee | Active PCB employee status waives the fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 25 | 65 | Yes | Yes |
| Student Checking | Not offered | Not offered | No | No |
| Everyday Checking | 25 | 65 | Yes | Yes |
| Interest Checking | Not offered | 65 | Yes | Yes |
| Premier Checking | Not offered | Not offered | Yes | Yes |
| Private Client Checking | Not offered | Not offered | No | Yes |

- The younger-than level waives the fee while the primary owner is younger than that age at cycle close.
- The at-least level waives the fee when the primary owner is at least that age at cycle close.
- The military column shows whether an active-duty military status on the customer profile waives the fee; the employee column shows whether an active PCB employee status on the customer profile waives it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical owners, derived from the table)

| Hypothetical owner at cycle close | Access Checking | Interest Checking | Premier Checking |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aged 24 | Younger-than waiver reached | Not offered | Not offered |
| Aged 25 exactly | Younger-than waiver not reached (25 is not younger than 25) | Not offered | Not offered |
| Aged 64 | No age waiver reached | At-least waiver not reached | Not offered |
| Aged 65 exactly | At-least waiver reached | At-least waiver reached | Not offered |
| Active-duty military status on profile | Waiver reached | Waiver reached | Waiver reached |

**Q: Does an active-duty military status waive the fee on Private Client Checking?**
A: No. The military column for Private Client Checking reads "No"; the employee status is the only profile-based waiver that tier offers.
